instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the raised annular pad on the existing top face. The pad height is 20 mm. Cut the pocket in this raised pad as shown using the supplied pocket sketch; the pocket depth is 11 mm and cuts downward into the pad. Mirror the base pad, raised pad, and pocket across the existing Sketch mirror plane so the matching geometry appears on the opposite side as shown. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
